data: Does the blue line represent the performance of CMLM-1 system?

The caption states that Figure 3 shows the BLEU scores of various systems with respect to the reference sentence lengths on WMT'14 EN-DE testset. The legend indicates that the blue line corresponds to the CMLM-1 system. Therefore, the blue line represents the performance of the CMLM-1 system.
